author: Nia Warfield
title: Friday, 21
text:
The " Fast Money " traders shared their first moves for the market open.
Pete Najarian was a buyer of Microsoft
Karen Finerman was a buyer of FedEx
Dan Nathan was a seller of the Semiconductor ETF
Tim Seymour was a buyer of Intel
